activity-date.narrative: Outcome 1: Improved and coordinated data collection and monitoring of the marine environment that also meet the findability, accessibility, interoperability and reusability (FAIR) data principals. Outcome 2: Improved understanding of natural capital and ecosystem services and how they are utilised by local communities and sea users. Outcome 3: The Maldives Government, Ministries and key stakeholders are able to identify and then mitigate threats to effectively manage their marine environment through an integrated approach. Outcome 4: Improved participation of all stakeholders including local communities and decision makers in the sustainable management of the marine environment. Outcome 5: Increased capacity through the delivery of equipment and training providing decision makers with the necessary tools to improve the sustainable management of marine resources.
